query: What fictional character created by Tom Clancy was turned into a film in 2002?

pipeline_result.response: Tom Clancy (Jack Ryan) was the fictional character created by Tom Clancy for the Jack Ryan universe.
retrieved_context: The Sum of All Fears: The Sum of All Fears is a best-selling thriller novel by Tom Clancy and part of the Jack Ryan universe.  It was the fourth of Clancy's "Jack Ryan" books to be turned into a film (2002).
Jack Ryan (character): Dr. John Patrick "Jack" Ryan Sr., KCVO (Hon.), Ph.D. is a fictional character created by Tom Clancy who appears in many of his novels and their respective film adaptations.
